Marta (People Ops): Heads-up: annual privacy attestation deadline is next Tue Apr 15 23:59 PT. If you haven't completed the microlearning, please do it today. Link: https://training.redwood/privacy-2026 :memo:
attest-bot: Reminder sent to 132 employees who haven't attested yet.
Kofi (Eng): Is the attestation required for contractors?
Marta (People Ops): Yes, all active contributors with access to internal systems. Contractors can reach out to People Ops for exceptions.
Elliot (Security): For folks handling customer logs, please attach the access justification doc in the attestation form.
Tara (Support): Where do we put a note if we need a one-week exception because of high support load?
Marta (People Ops): Use the exception form linked in the attestation flow and cc people-ops. We'll approve limited exceptions case-by-case.
Kofi (Eng): Cool, thanks. I'll push a reminder in my team channel.
Marta (People Ops): Thanks everyone 1F44D
